gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (cash basis governmental funds) Total receipts 13,360,009 = General 8,453,342 + Street 2,883,040 + Economic Development 1,058,652 + Recreational Agency 0 + Debt Service 791,883 + Community Development Agency 173,092. detail[] = budget schedules General p8 (8,445,954), Street p9 (2,883,040), Economic Development p10 (1,058,652) = 12,387,646. Missing fund columns (no schedule): Debt Service Fund Taxes 571,999 + Utility franchise fees 185,430 + State revenue 34,454 = 791,883; Community Development Agency Fund TIF project property taxes 67,004 + Charges for services 105,287 + Investment income 801 = 173,092. Missing line: the General budget schedule leaves out the General column 'TIF project property taxes' 7,388 (8,453,342 - 8,445,954 = 7,388; the schedule's tax lines 1,233,253 + 2,615 + 2,896,011 + 404,780 = 4,536,659 = the statement's General Taxes, so the TIF row is not inside them). 12,387,646 + 791,883 + 173,092 + 7,388 = 13,360,009 = statement_total. Debt Service taxes are not broken down by type in the trim, so category taxes. The Debt Service column's 'Debt issuance' 2,505,000 is also added (section other financing; not in the revenue sum).

gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Transfers in Total 1,695,117 = General 973,225 + Street 411,392 + Debt Service 310,500. detail[] = General 973,225 (p8) + Street 2,584,427 (p9) = 3,557,652. Part 1, missing fund column: Debt Service Fund 310,500 (no schedule) -> added; detail becomes 3,868,152. Part 2, different basis: the Street Department budget schedule p9 prints its transfers gross (in 2,584,427, out 2,173,035), while the statement's Street column prints only the net 411,392 (= 2,584,427 - 2,173,035). Remaining difference 1,695,117 - 3,868,152 = -2,173,035 = exactly the Street gross transfers out printed on p9; both figures are as printed, no further fix.

gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Transfers out Total (1,695,117) = General (265,334) + Economic Development (53,270) + Recreational Agency (973,225) + Debt Service (403,288). detail[] = General -265,334 (p8) + Street -2,173,035 (p9) + Economic Development -53,270 (p10) = 2,491,639. Part 1, missing fund columns (no schedule): Recreational Agency Fund (973,225) and Debt Service Fund (403,288) -> added; detail becomes 3,868,152. Part 2, different basis: the Street budget schedule p9 prints transfers out 2,173,035 gross, which the statement's Street column nets into its 411,392 transfers in (the statement prints no Street transfer out). Remaining difference 1,695,117 - 3,868,152 = -2,173,035 = the Street gross amount; as printed, no further fix.
